scope: FMP-12a-R2 / engine-metrics-binding / candidate; F(n) simulation tick execution time vs U(n) frame interval binding, Unity scheduler callbacks, dual histogram recording, 0-tick frame safety, and protocol run requirements. It does not claim issue 150 acceptance or issue 140/141/142 whole acceptance.

claims.title: F(n) Simulation Tick vs U(n) Frame Interval Semantic Separation

Fn.name: SimulationTickMilliseconds
Fn.meaning: Pure CPU execution duration of TickServer() fixed simulation tick under population n

Un.name: FrameMilliseconds
Un.meaning: Elapsed interval between successive engine Update() cycles (Time.unscaledDeltaTime * 1000.0) under population n

claims.compatibility: Schema 1 envelope preserves TickCount and TickMilliseconds for legacy parsers while populating distinct SimulationTickMilliseconds and FrameMilliseconds histograms.

claims.title: Zero-Tick Frame Integrity and Boundary Carry
guarantees: Frames with zero simulation ticks (accumulator < 0.05f) still invoke RecordFrameMetrics, preserving periodic 5-second interval metric flushes.
SimulationTickStart and SimulationTickEnd remain equal during 0-tick intervals without advancing tick counters.
Population counters (ConnectedClients, NpcCount, ActiveIncidents) hold prior values across 0-tick intervals without inventing zeroes.
Exact boundary carry guarantees SimulationTickEnd of interval k equals SimulationTickStart of interval k+1.

claims.title: Mock Accumulator vs Engine Runtime Differentiation
claims.negativeCase: Source-only RuntimeMetricAccumulator test success shall never be equated with or promoted to actual multiplayer protocol run acceptance.
divergenceGuards: Histogram boundary bin overflow (> 2000ms) is tracked rather than clamped.
Non-monotonic time, negative population, and backwards clock jumps without explicit flag are rejected atomically.
Returned DTO snapshots are detached deep clones and do not alias accumulator state.

claims.title: Protocol Run Verification with Coupled Players
claims.dependencyPrerequisite: Execution of coupled Player protocol runs strictly requires verified causal corpus (#149) and runnable Player payloads (#143). In the absence of built standalone payloads, protocol runs remain honestly recorded as PENDING_RUNNABLE_PAYLOAD.
